response: Yes, preloading with colloids can prevent hemodynamic changes when neurosurgical patients are subsequently changed to the seated position. According to the available data, preloading colloid fluid prior to repositioning could prevent the decrease of systolic blood pressure and central venous pressure during sitting positioning without other complications. This suggests that preloading with colloids can be an effective strategy to maintain hemodynamic stability in neurosurgical patients who require a change in position.
